instructions:
1. Set the suspension trainer handles to about waist height and stand facing the anchor with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold the handles with a neutral grip and lean back with arms extended, body straight from head to heels.
3. Pull the handles toward your face, driving your elbows high and out to shoulder level.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
5. Extend your arms slowly to return to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced so your hips do not sag.
2. Lead with the elbows high to target the rear delts and mid back.
3. Do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears.
4. Adjust foot position to set the difficulty.

instructions:
1. Set the suspension trainer handles to about knee height and lie on your back beneath the anchor.
2. Place your heels in the handles with knees bent and arms by your sides.
3. Press your heels down and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top so your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
5. Lower your hips slowly to the floor.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you lift and inhale as you lower.
2. Drive through your glutes and hamstrings, not your lower back.
3. Keep your core braced to stabilize the straps.
4. Use a mat to cushion your back.

instructions:
1. Set the suspension trainer handles to about waist height and sit beneath the anchor.
2. Hold the handles with an overhand grip and extend your legs, resting your feet on a bench.
3. Lift your hips so your body is straight from head to heels, arms extended.
4. Pull your chest toward the handles, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Lower your body slowly to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you pull and inhale as you lower.
2. Lead with the back, retracting the shoulder blades before bending the elbows.
3. Keep your hips up so the body stays in a straight line.
4. Do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears.

instructions:
1. Set the suspension trainer handles to about waist height and sit beneath the anchor.
2. Hold the handles with a neutral grip and extend your legs straight on the floor.
3. Lift your hips so your body is straight from head to heels, arms extended.
4. Pull your chest toward the handles while twisting your palms to face backward at the top.
5. Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then untwist and extend your arms to return.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
2. Exhale as you pull and twist, inhale as you lower.
3. Squeeze the shoulder blades together to engage the upper back.
4. Keep your core braced to resist rotation.

instructions:
1. Set the suspension trainer handles to about waist height and sit beneath the anchor.
2. Hold the handles with a neutral grip, knees bent and feet flat.
3. Lean back with arms extended and lift your feet, tucking your knees toward your chest.
4. Pull your chest toward the handles, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades.
5. Extend your arms slowly to return to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso braced and stable while tucking the knees.
2. Exhale as you pull and inhale as you return.
3. Lead the pull with the back rather than the arms.
4. Keep the knee tuck controlled to engage the abs.
